subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Avaliar os riscos envolvidos em atividades cotidianas, aplicando conhecimentos das Ciências da Natureza, para justificar o uso de equipamentos e recursos, bem como comportamentos de segurança, visando à integridade física, individual e coletiva, e socioambiental, podendo fazer uso de dispositivos e aplicativos digitais que viabilizem a estruturação de simulações de tais riscos.

components.description_pt: Identificar riscos presentes em atividades cotidianas usando conhecimento de Ciências Naturais
components.description_en: Identify risks present in everyday activities using Natural Sciences knowledge
components.cc_component_description: Identify natural Earth processes that pose risks or impacts to human communities

components.description_pt: Justificar o uso de equipamentos de segurança e comportamentos para proteger integridade individual e coletiva
components.description_en: Justify the use of safety equipment and behaviors to protect individual and collective integrity
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a proposed investigation or design solution for adherence to safety and ethical standards

components.description_pt: Aplicar conceitos de Ciências Naturais para avaliar riscos socioambientais na vida diária
components.description_en: Apply Natural Sciences concepts to evaluate socio-environmental risks in daily life
components.cc_component_description: Compare the relative environmental impacts of different choices people make in daily life

components.description_pt: Usar ferramentas de modelagem digital ou simulação para representar e analisar riscos cotidianos
components.description_en: Use digital modeling or simulation tools to represent and analyze everyday risks
components.cc_component_description: Create a computational model or simulation to represent a phenomenon, process, or system

cc_matches.description: Plan and conduct an investigation or test a design solution in a safe and ethical manner including considerations of environmental, social, and personal impacts.
Generate and compare multiple solutions to reduce the impacts of natural Earth processes on humans.
Things that people do to live comfortably can affect the world around them. But they can make choices that reduce their impacts on the land, water, air, and other living things.
Create and/or revise a computational model or simulation of a phenomenon, designed device, process, or system.
